title: availability
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/availability, ROS to HA, QoS 1, retained, no expiry. This is NOT a JSON payload: the wire bytes are the plain words online or offline with no quotes, no schema field and no object wrapper. 'online' is published on connect; 'offline' is the Last Will and is also published on clean shutdown. Validators wrap the plain bytes as a JSON string before checking them against this schema, which is why the example files contain a quoted string.
